achievements.name: Start with a bang!
achievements.desc: Take out the last line of defense at Quality Assurance.

achievements.name: Cream of the Crop
achievements.desc: Come out on top with a battle against the head of Production.

achievements.name: This will cost you big time
achievements.desc: Drain development's budget, removing creative control.

achievements.name: The Negotiator
achievements.desc: Remove the head of Security from the equation.

achievements.name: Headliner
achievements.desc: Be the showstopper for the head of Marketing.

achievements.name: Time to pay up!
achievements.desc: Settle the bill with the head of Finance.

achievements.name: Who's the boss now?
achievements.desc: Take it up with the CEO, and come out on top.

achievements.name: Easy Listening
achievements.desc: Finish the game completing every level on the Easy difficulty.

achievements.name: Well that was a rush!
achievements.desc: Finish the game and complete every level on the Normal difficulty.

achievements.desc: Finish the game and complete every level on the Hard difficulty.

achievements.name: And the crowd goes wild!
achievements.desc: Finish the game and complete every level on the Very Hard difficulty.

achievements.name: Didn't skip a beat!
achievements.desc: Finish the game and complete every level on the Rhythm Master difficulty.

achievements.name: Problem solved... wait, what?
achievements.desc: Discover the deeper mystery behind the SPECTRA doors on campus.

achievements.name: I can't see this ever being a problem again
achievements.desc: Solve the problem once and for all in an epic battle.

achievements.name: Thanks for the free chip, Peppermint!
achievements.desc: Purchase and equip your first upgrade chip.

achievements.name: Chip-tuned
achievements.desc: Increase your chip slots to the maximum capacity.

achievements.name: I play my own way!
achievements.desc: Purchase and equip your first Special Attack.

achievements.name: Whoa! There's ANOTHER health bar!?

achievements.name: I think that's enough health for now

achievements.name: Fully Powered Up!
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade your Reverb Gauge to the maximum.

achievements.name: I have to read these things?

achievements.name: I have to read ALL of these things?

achievements.name: Feeling the beat!
achievements.desc: Land 20 beat-hit attacks on enemies.

achievements.name: Beat-hit mania
achievements.desc: Land 500 beat-hit attacks on enemies.

achievements.name: You got this, Peppermint?
achievements.desc: Destroy 10 barriers by calling in Peppermint.

achievements.name: You must like calling me in, Chai
achievements.desc: Destroy 50 barriers by calling in Peppermint.

achievements.name: Z-shielding's got nothing on us!
achievements.desc: Shatter 10 enemy shields by calling in Macaron.

achievements.name: I think I found your calling, Macaron
achievements.desc: Shatter 50 enemy shields by calling in Macaron.

achievements.name: Out in a puff of smoke

achievements.name: This is a breeze!
achievements.desc: Put out 50 fires in battle with Korsica. (Enemies included.)

achievements.name: Perfect Parry
achievements.desc: Sucessfully parry with perfect timing 15 times.

achievements.name: Perfecter Parry-er!
achievements.desc: Sucessfully parry with perfect timing 200 times.

achievements.name: Uh, they were broken when I got here
achievements.desc: Destroy 200 Vandelay security robots.

achievements.name: That's a lot of junk metal…
achievements.desc: Destroy 500 Vandelay security robots.

achievements.name: OK, well THEY came after ME!
achievements.desc: Destroy 1000 Vandelay security robots.

achievements.name: Kissing the sky!
achievements.desc: Perform 50 Aerial Raves.

achievements.name: We're Jammin'
achievements.desc: Successfully pull off 20 Jam Combos

achievements.name: I'm not done with you yet
achievements.desc: Overkill 20 enemies.

achievements.name: First we parry, then we counter
achievements.desc: Perform 20 parry counters using any partner.

achievements.name: Now this is how you fight like a team!
achievements.desc: Perform 100 parry counters using any partner.

achievements.name: My Ultimate Setlist
achievements.desc: Complete all the floors in the Rhythm Tower.

achievements.name: I look cool. But I can look COOLER.
achievements.desc: Equip any costume.

achievements.name: What a journey it was...

achievements.name: This was... not what I expected.

achievements.name: There's such a thing as TOO helpful

achievements.name: Have we met before?

achievements.name: Who put gears in there?

achievements.name: Alright, that felt AWESOME!
achievements.desc: Defeated your first enemy with a Rhythm Parry Attack.

achievements.name: I hit things with a guitar really well.

achievements.name: I'm untouchable!

achievements.name: You can pet the cat!
achievements.desc: Play with 808 in the hideout.

achievements.name: Wanna hear my playlist?

achievements.name: Does that say weakpoint?

achievements.name: I told you I'd be fine, Peppermint!

achievements.name: You ever parry a volcano?

achievements.name: I am a good person who likes to help
achievements.desc: Help out 3 Vandelay robots with their pressing issues.

achievements.name: I'm trying to FOCUS HERE!
achievements.desc: Find and shoot down every hovering announcement drone.

achievements.name: With our powers combined…and to the rhythm…
achievements.desc: Perfectly time your take down of your largest foe yet in a musical finale.

achievements.name: I saw all those hits coming a measure away!
achievements.desc: Perfectly parry every non-boss enemy's Rhythm Parry attack. (Only for enemies in the main game.)

achievements.name: Check out my moves!
achievements.desc: Purchase every combo and partner attack.

achievements.name: OK, I THINK I know what I'm doing now
achievements.desc: Successfully pull off every combo and attack in the Training Room.

achievements.name: NOW we got a kickass hideout!

achievements.name: Call me Turbo Chai
achievements.desc: Clear a run of BPM RUSH! (Easy or Normal difficulty.)

achievements.name: Choose your own adventure
achievements.desc: Clear a run of Power Up! Tower Up!

achievements.name: It'll do, CNMN

achievements.name: Please don't make this awkward
achievements.desc: Unlock the Special Attack "My Hero!" and use it in battle.

achievements.name: That was just EVIL
achievements.desc: Clear BPM RUSH! on EX Mode.

achievements.name: New bad guys? No problem!
achievements.desc: Perfectly parry both KEM-N0 and DM-ET1L's rhythm parry attack.

achievements.name: It was all for this
achievements.desc: Finally get your hands on that gift basket.

achievements.name: Voices from within
achievements.desc: Read all messages from the developers.

achievements.name: Low budget finish
achievements.desc: Defeat the main game final boss wearing the "Low Budget" Costume for Chai (with guitar) and 808.
